_running_note: SHOW-ACTIVE-ONLY, the RUNNING half (task-b66928b2958c8cfa). While a turn is
RUNNING the transcript keeps the ACTIVE tool row and folds the rows BEFORE
it behind one '+N previous' control. These cases pin BOTH the hidden-row
count N and the control's text, and BOTH suites read them:
'row_outputs' is each row's tool_result output in transcript order; an EMPTY
string is a row whose result has not arrived — still executing. The ACTIVE
row is the FIRST row still awaiting its result, or the LAST row when every
result already landed (the model is thinking, not tooling). N is how many
rows sit BEFORE the active one, so a null 'control' means N=0: nothing is
hidden and NO control is drawn. Add a case here BEFORE changing either
